description: Search US federal rules, proposed rules, notices and presidential documents in the Federal Register by words, agency (SEC, EPA, FDA, CFTC or any name), type and date, or list what's open for public comment. Each result has the agency, publication date, comment deadline and days left, effective date, docket, comments received, abstract and links to the document, PDF and comment page. Up to 20 per call, newest or most relevant first. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

agency.description: Agency acronym, name or slug (SEC, Environmental Protection Agency)

openForComment.description: true: only documents still taking public comments

name: federal_register_search
